newsitem.title: THAILAND: Grammy sees 18 pct profit rise in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Grammy sees 18 pct profit rise in 1997.

text.p: Grammy Entertainment Plc said on Monday its net profit is expected to rise to 688 million baht this year from 582.9 million in 1996 and 442.4 million a year earlier.

Grammy's chairman Paiboon Damrongchaitham told reporters the expected higher earnings this year could mainly be attributed to increased sales of educational materials through its Suesaphan franchised outlets which will increase to 60 sites by end-1997 from a current 15.
"Sales by our Suesaphan outlets should rise to 1.65 billion baht from 380 million in 1996," Paiboon said.
